name: Mainline only
purpose: Keep both club lines clear and leave all the space behind them for your display.

name: Back-out siding
purpose: Take the inner turnout onto a short spur. Reverse to return to the mainline.

name: Ballasted switch return
purpose: Follow the ballasted right turnout and return curve onto a parallel siding.

name: Four-track yard throat
purpose: Follow the R40 ladder to three branches. Add straight storage behind it.

name: Diagonal loading spur
purpose: Spot freight cars on a 48-stud diagonal spur behind the inner track.

name: Long back-out siding
purpose: Park along 64 studs of straight track, parallel to the display front.

name: Double crossover
purpose: Move a train from either club mainline onto the other.

name: Drive-through siding
purpose: Enter at one turnout and rejoin at the other without reversing.

name: Rear parking
purpose: Turn back behind the display on seven R40 curves.

name: Two-track arrival siding
purpose: Hold two trains behind the display on 80- and 64-stud storage tracks.

name: Three-track parking yard
purpose: Choose among three storage tracks with 64, 48 and 32 straight studs.

name: Perpendicular freight spur
purpose: Turn away from the public edge and run 80 straight studs into the display.
